subject: Engineering Fundamentals
title: Energy Storage: The Grid's Missing Piece
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Energy Storage: The Grid's Missing Piece.

hook.text: The grid has no warehouse. Electricity must be used the instant it's generated — unless you store it.

buildup.text: Lithium-ion batteries dominate grid storage now. Tesla's Hornsdale battery in Australia stabilizes the grid and earns profit.

discovery.text: Flow batteries use liquid electrolytes in tanks. Scale them up just by adding more liquid — independent of power rating.

twist.text: Gravity storage lifts heavy blocks with excess energy and drops them to generate power later. Astonishingly simple.

climax.text: Affordable storage is the key to 100% renewable grids. Without it, solar and wind can't replace fossil fuels.

punchline.text: Generate when the wind blows. Use it when the wind stops. Storage bridges the gap.

quiz.question: How does gravity-based energy storage work?
options: Compressed air is pumped underground and released through turbines
Heavy blocks are lifted with excess energy and dropped to generate power later
Water is frozen at night and melted during the day to spin generators
